name: Scotland Loves Animation
blurb: A touring UK anime film festival with feature premieres and industry guests, run by distributor Anime Limited.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: 'SCOTLAND LOVES ANIME 2026 GLASGOW: 6TH - 8TH NOVEMBER EDINBURGH: 16TH - 22ND NOVEMBER LONDON: TBC'; the Glasgow Film Theatre sub-page confirms '6TH - 8TH NOVEMBER 2026' and the Edinburgh Filmhouse sub-page confirms '16TH - 22ND NOVEMBER 2026'.

notes: One brand, one 2026 edition, run as legs in several cities: Glasgow Film Theatre 6-8 Nov 2026, then Edinburgh Filmhouse (88 Lothian Rd) 16-22 Nov 2026, plus a London leg announced only as 'TBC' (no date/venue yet, so not included in the start/end span above). The site's own /cinema/edinburgh sub-page is stale and still shows 2025 dates; the homepage and /cinema/edinburgh-filmhouse page were used instead. Guests/industry lineup not announced yet as of this research date (a late-Sept 2026 festival post said full line-up details were 'coming soon'). The site carries no event key art or og/twitter image, only partner logos (Filmhub, HMV, All the Anime); All the Anime (Anime Limited) is the festival's own organiser, so its logo is used as the cover rather than an unrelated sponsor mark.
